prompt: [INST] Name one health benefit of eating fruits. [/INST]
response: One health benefit of eating fruits is that they provide the body with essential vitamins and minerals. Fruits are rich in nutrients such as vitamin C, potassium, and fiber, which help to support the immune system, maintain healthy blood pressure, and promote digestive health, respectively. Consuming a diet that is rich in fruits can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases and improve overall health.
